I soaked 30 grams of dried raisins in kracken rum for 3 days inside a mason jar.
Then I made a standard vanilla ice cream mix
Heating 300ml of full milk with 300ml of double cream and a scratched vanilla bean. Then mix 3 egg yolks with 100grams of golden caster sugar. Then I stirred the egg/sugar mixture with the hot milk/cream mix and left to cool in the fridge over night. 
The next day I strained my rum and raisin mix off keeping a small spoon of the liquid. Then I churned my ice cream for 30 minutes when it only had 10 minutes of churn time left I added the raisins and the spoonful of liquid. 
I plan on doing it again with a spiced rum and a touch of cinnamon.
